RESIDENTIAL LEASE AND WEBSITE TERMS OF USE

This combined instrument sets out the residential lease between Granite Park Properties LLC ("Landlord") and the individual tenant identified on the signature page ("Tenant"), and the terms of use governing the consumer's access to the Landlord's resident portal.

1. Acceptance

1.1 By using the resident portal, by browsing any page of the site, or by continuing to use the Service after any change to these terms, the consumer is deemed to have agreed to these terms in their entirety. No signature, click or other affirmative step is required.

2. Premises and Condition

2.1 Tenant accepts the premises in their present condition and waives the implied warranty of habitability. Landlord shall have no duty to keep the premises in a habitable condition or to make any repair necessary to render the premises fit for human habitation.

2.2 Tenant waives all rights and remedies under the state landlord-tenant act, waives the covenant of quiet enjoyment, and waives the right to any notice prior to entry, eviction or termination.

3. Reviews and Public Statements

3.1 Tenant and consumer shall not post, publish or communicate any negative review, rating, comment or other statement concerning Landlord, the premises or the Service on any website, review platform or social medium. Any such review shall be removed at the consumer's expense.

4. Disputes

4.1 Before bringing any claim, the consumer shall give Landlord ninety (90) days' prior written notice and a ninety (90) day period in which to cure. Landlord may bring any claim against the consumer immediately, without prior notice and without affording any cure period.

4.2 Any claim shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration, and the consumer waives any right to participate in a class action or class-wide arbitration.

5. User Content

5.1 The consumer may upload photographs and other material to the Service, and Landlord may do with it as Landlord sees fit.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this instrument.
